author: captain
question_zh: 在已注册的 441 日 MLPLOB v3 CSZ 配方、1.32 预算点、同三种子下，把 12 列原始盘口扩成 18 列（追加 6 个由 1 分钟快照因果推导的盘口变化/订单流不平衡通道），能否在 8 个筛查窗上稳定超过**同宽度但派生通道恒零**的对照臂？
hypothesis_zh: 1 分钟快照只能给出 OFI 的代理量，真正的信息在于盘口变化的方向与幅度而非绝对价位；若这些派生通道携带增量信息，则 ofi 臂应稳定优于 zero6 臂（同宽度、同参数量、同预算），并且 zero6 臂应约等于 12 列基线（宽度本身无效应）。

definition.width: 12 -> 18 columns, both arms identical width and parameter count (362,081 -> 362,333)
definition.mask: a row whose best bid or best ask is <=0 or non-finite zeroes the six derived channels and their observed bits; the raw twelve columns are untouched
definition.causality: computed from bars at or before the prediction timestamp only; lookback windows never read future rows

default_path_unchanged.claim: feature_set=raw is bit-identical to the registered 441-day path

evidence.three_way: unedited repo_featnorm / repo_ofi reverted / repo_ofi patched all agree

arms.control: raw_plus_zero6 (same width, the 6 channels are constant zero)
arms.why_the_control_matters: ofi-vs-baseline would confound the six channels with the extra width and the extra input-layer parameters; zero6 absorbs both.

code_repo: /root/repo_ofi (patched copy of repo_featnorm; uncommitted, HEAD f7d8f13)

primary.pairing: candidate minus control within (seed, window, trading day), then mean over the three seeds
primary.estimator: 5-trading-day moving block bootstrap with ceil(n/5) blocks, 20000 draws, seed 20261028 (scripts/compare_blend_replay.py, sha 0bf08a4783c397ab3d05ec3e2f3ef7899ea94cbd44db4d7cee42cf4e0ddbc4d1); older single-block estimator never gates
primary.evaluation: eval-v2: quantile 0.2, periods_per_year 252, min_cross_section 3, consistent portfolios undefined, single_side_rate 0.0, return_sections True

secondary.zero6_minus_baseline: width control; expected near zero, reported not gated
report: per-seed sign of ofi minus zero6
masked row fraction and per-channel stats after masking/clipping

thresholds.why_0.002_zh: 这是机制检验（同宽度两臂只差六个通道的内容），配对后 165 天 × 3 种子的标准误约 0.0009–0.0014，0.002 约等于 1.5–2 个标准误；比提交候选的 0.003 低，因为它不需要跨过换手与打包门槛。即便通过，也只构成“值得进晋升流程”的必要条件，不构成提交候选——封存窗已经花掉。

decision_rule_zh: score_pass 当且仅当 ofi−zero6 的池化配对均值 ≥ +0.002、修正口径 95% 区间不含零、8 个筛查窗中至少 7 个为正。任一不满足则关闭该路线（不再增加配置、不扩种子），并把结论写进决定登记。通过则由队长决定是否把它推进到“候选级”流程（需要重新做换手匹配、晋升门与打包，且只能用开发窗）。
what_would_falsify: ofi 与 zero6 的差值落在零附近或为负
zero6 明显优于 12 列基线（说明宽度/参数量本身就是效应，特征内容不是）
差值只在少数窗口为正、或换手大幅退化超过 0.0318

cost.runs: 6 (3 seeds x 2 arms), 145405 steps each with the 1.33 anchor
cost.host: hz-4 (24 cores / 172 GB, 3x RTX 3090): cold streaming pool about 18 min, then about 55-60 min of training at 21-24 ms/step
cost.replay: 6 versions x 8 screening windows on a replay host, about 25-30 min

confirmations_reserved.reads: at most one per route, released by the captain only
confirmations_reserved.note: a ten-window or 203-day pooled number anywhere counts as spending the confirmation budget

scope_limits_zh: 掩码与裁剪口径是我裁定的（单侧 0 价也掩码、固定常量裁剪），与题面“mid<=0 才置 0”的措辞不同；raw 12 列逐位未动
派生通道由 1 分钟快照推导，最多是 OFI 的代理量，不是真实逐笔订单流
只测 1.32 一个预算点；2.64 及更长的训练量不在本轮
注册时不锁定训练机；实际用 hz-4，代码与配方路径与本机一致
